question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

At daggers drawn with

options.text: To be bitterly hostile towards each other
To help someone in time of need

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "At daggers drawn with"** is used to denote a state of extreme hostility or bitterness, as if ready to fight.
 
• It is** derived from** the historical act of drawing one's dagger, ready for combat.
 
• The** correct alternative** which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase "At daggers drawn with" is: **"To be bitterly hostile towards each other"**(किसी के साथ कट्टर द्वेष रखना)

Therefore, the** correct answer **is: '*To be bitterly hostile towards each other'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"At the lowest estimate" **- This phrase means to consider the minimum possible value or amount(न्यूनतम अनुमान के हिसाब से).
 
• **"To accept someone" - **This means to recognize, appreciate or agree to someone(किसी को स्वीकार करना).
 
• **"To help someone in time of need" -** This phrase signifies the act of providing assistance when someone is in difficulty(जरूरत के समय किसी की मदद करना).
 
 

3f:T4a0,
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
